clips.title: The story
paras: Menara Voidrender awaits Horde warlocks ready for deeper study in Ratchet. From the Undercity, they cross the Great Sea to her hilltop refuge above the port.

Kaal Soulreaper watches warlocks grow more skilled in the Undercity. When one outgrows simple hexes and impish thralls, he sends them across the Great Sea for specialized instruction. Demonic control leaves little room for error. A skilled mentor can help a warlock survive the volatile powers of the Nether.

Strahad Farsan’s tower rises from a high bluff above Ratchet. Away from the scrutiny of city guards, practitioners such as Menara Voidrender teach younger initiates. Warlocks from different backgrounds set aside tribal and political rivalries. The demons they bargain with will consume human, orc, or Forsaken alike if their summoner’s will falters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You don't have all the accoutrements, but it's plain to see you're ready--the air around you exudes greater confidence. Yes, I see it now.
Menara Voidrender would teach you a few things if you feel you're ready. She spends her time tutoring younger students in the arcane. She even gives gifts to those who pass her tests.
Go to Ratchet in the Barrens if you're interested. She's above the city in Strahad's tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Kaal sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, friend, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
